original_operative_vs_draft_note: 2022 nutraceutical schedule exists under interim operational directions effective 01 Oct 2022 according to 18 Oct direction; do not claim June 2022 draft was notified as final regulations, do not presume older 2016 schedules map one-for-one or remain fully controlling. Check later original legal instruments before approval.

source_register.auth_scope: Metal named-substance rows, chemical Indian Pharmacopoeia note; separate total-aflatoxin and B1 table.
Appendix A food category system is for use of additives; categories not legal product designations; processing aids require identity/purity.
18 October 2022 direction re-operationalises March and May 2022 directions effective 1 October 2022; still requires checking later instruments.
24 June 2022 draft is not evidence of final regulation enactment; Schedule labels must be mapped to governing date.
Broad classes of substances, additives, enzymes and premixes; no marketed supplier identity.
Generated ingredient/additive statement not licence or legal determination.
2016 Schedule VA-VF, IV, VI, VIII names cannot automatically be mapped to 2022 operationalised numbering.

cases.product_name: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.official_text_findings_not_case_approval: FPSFA Appendix A is explicitly a food additive use/category system; categories are not legal food product designations. The CTR lead table separately lists named chemicals, additives and a chemical-monograph proviso. A broad 'additives permitted' licence entry does not establish one lead maximum.
cases.forbidden_automatic_transfer: Do not apply a named additive's lead maximum, the general chemicals row, or a Codex purity monograph uniformly to every Appendix A additive. Food-additive use permissions and impurity specifications answer different questions.
cases.next_original_documents: Named additive E/INS/CAS, exact form/grade, intended function, actual supplier and manufacturer's standard/CoA; operative source clause or purity specification and legal scope; accredited method/matrix/LOQ; tested lot.

cases.product_name: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
cases.official_text_findings_not_case_approval: FoSCoS retains an additive-class label 'Additives VA–VF' from nutraceutical regulation scheduling. FSSAI's signed October 2022 direction records operationalization/re-operationalization of a changed 2022 framework; the 2022 draft and historic 2016 Schedule VA–VF cannot by their names alone identify today's exact permitted additive or lead impurity requirement.
cases.forbidden_automatic_transfer: Do not claim June 2022 draft has final-Gazette status or that VA–VF entries automatically equal revised 2022 schedule numbers; no whole-class lead maximum.
cases.next_original_documents: Specific named INS/CAS additive, relevant category (HS/Nutra/FSDU/FSMP), intended date/use and controlled formulation; last operative schedule/direction and allowed dose/purity; original lead/monograph and accredited lab/lot.

cases.product_name: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.official_text_findings_not_case_approval: FPSFA processing-aid text defines EC (Enzyme Commission) number for enzyme activity; purity and food-grade/residue management concern the specific processing aid and use. FSSAI's signed May/October 2022 nutraceutical directions separately address enzymes/proteins for health supplements. A generic 'permitted enzymes and their preparations' category cannot be treated as a single chemical or as every processing aid.
cases.forbidden_automatic_transfer: No universal lead maximum or 'IP monograph' inference for all enzyme preparations; neither enzyme EC designation nor a processing-aid category is a metal method, a lab accreditation or a lot release.
cases.next_original_documents: Exact enzyme EC number and commercial preparation, source organism (GMO/GMM as applicable), carriers, technological role as ingredient versus processing aid, controlled purity specification; exact permitted use, legal lead article/monograph and NABL matrix-specific CoA.

cases.product_name: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.official_text_findings_not_case_approval: CTR 2.2.1 total aflatoxins names cereals, figs, arecanut, nuts, oilseeds/oil, pulses, spices and products containing named foods; the B1 table has separately described limits. Generic 2016 Nutraceutical Schedules IV/VI/VIII encompass heterogeneous botanical and functional ingredients and do not make every one of them one CTR crop article.
cases.forbidden_automatic_transfer: Do not paste total-aflatoxin 20 µg/kg or B1 10 µg/kg containing-food comparison into all nutraceutical ingredients; first prove a listed crop identity and decide whether the raw ingredient or a food product containing the crop row applies.
cases.next_original_documents: Actual botanical Latin name/part and form or chemical ingredient, named 2016 versus operational 2022 schedule with current permitted status, ingredient specification, crop class and traceability; original operative CTR row for both analytes, method LOQ and lot CoA.

cases.official_text_findings_not_case_approval: CTR 2.2.1 separately says 'food product containing any of the above-mentioned food articles' for total aflatoxins and for B1; the published comparative rows are 20 µg/kg total and 10 µg/kg B1 respectively. A functional premix requires authenticated constituent identity and final commercial form to know whether it is such a food product.
cases.forbidden_automatic_transfer: A mere FoSCoS premix label or existence of one botanical nutrient does not prove the ingredient is a listed food crop or that the finished-premix containing-product comparator automatically applies. Total, B1, and Aflatoxin M1 cannot be mixed.
cases.next_original_documents: Signed full premix BOM with each plant/crop source, weight percent, carriers, processing form, intended direct consumption or manufacture and food category; exact current CTR containing-food meaning, separate total/B1 method and as-sold sample-basis/lot.

later_legal_review_required: Original statute text, later notifications, category-to-named substance/BOM authentication, source laboratory scope, representative as-sold lot remain unknown.
